The mixture was stirred at 23 °C for 1 h, and then at 80 °C for 3 h in a preheated aluminum block. The reaction vessel was allowed to cool to 23 °C and the mixture was filtered by passage through a plug of silica gel (EtOAC eluent, 5 mL), and then concentrated under reduced pressure.
